scope.production: Semantic drawIndex metadata, WGSL immediate declaration, four-byte pipeline layout, and per-command render encoding.
scope.compatibility: Default WebGPU BatchedMesh remains immediate-free and existing WebGL BatchedMesh transports remain intact.
scope.example: Deterministic comparison of drawIndex command ordinals and batchIndirectIndex instance IDs.
scope.tests: Seven focused QUnit groups covering shader generation, capabilities, metadata, pipeline lifecycle, callsites, and command traces.

claimBoundary: Correctness on one tested Chrome/WebGPU implementation; no performance or universal browser/device claim.
